name: Apple Music + Timbre
subtitle: Apple Music experiments and Timbre Safari EQ
description: AM+T sideloading source for Gecko + Safari extension test builds and the earlier native MusicKit/WebKit prototype. Safari protected audio EQ has not been verified.

apps.name: Apple Music + Timbre (Gecko + Safari)
apps.subtitle: Gecko player with bundled Safari EQ extension
apps.localizedDescription: The native Apple Music + Timbre shell uses cached Gecko and includes a separate Timbre Safari WebExtension. Apple Music full protected-track EQ and Radio are experimental, not confirmed.

versions.localizedDescription: Rolled back build 10 Gecko view focus/activation behavior after a reported regression; returns to build 9 Gecko lifecycle. Audio output and protected playback remain unverified.
versions.changelog: Rolled back build 10 Gecko view focus/activation behavior after a reported regression; returns to build 9 Gecko lifecycle. Audio output and protected playback remain unverified.

versions.localizedDescription: Reassert Gecko session active/focused state after the browser UIView attaches and expose a Gecko surface lifecycle readout. This tests a possible cause of silent Gecko media; audible playback remains unverified.
versions.changelog: Reassert Gecko session active/focused state after the browser UIView attaches and expose a Gecko surface lifecycle readout. This tests a possible cause of silent Gecko media; audible playback remains unverified.

versions.localizedDescription: Added an independent native two-second audio test with physical-audibility reporting. Explicitly activates iOS playback session before Gecko playback and adds route and volume diagnostics. MusicKit signing and protected audio remain unresolved.
versions.changelog: Added an independent native two-second audio test with physical-audibility reporting. Explicitly activates iOS playback session before Gecko playback and adds route and volume diagnostics. MusicKit signing and protected audio remain unresolved.

versions.localizedDescription: Avoid blocking native station-error alerts; show sanitized MusicKit token-case and installed bundle ID. Added an audible local Web Audio/WAV test inside Gecko. No protected audio access or EQ was added.
versions.changelog: Avoid blocking native station-error alerts; show sanitized MusicKit token-case and installed bundle ID. Added an audible local Web Audio/WAV test inside Gecko. No protected audio access or EQ was added.

versions.localizedDescription: Added an observation-only native Core Audio callback probe with in-app inspect action and copyable counts. It does not decrypt, capture or EQ MusicKit samples; protected stream support remains unverified.
versions.changelog: Added an observation-only native Core Audio callback probe with in-app inspect action and copyable counts. It does not decrypt, capture or EQ MusicKit samples; protected stream support remains unverified.

versions.localizedDescription: Added in-app Copy/Share debug reporting with real subscription, song and station catalog requests and NSError domain/code details, plus exportable Gecko EME test results and timeout handling. MusicKit signing capabilities and protected music EQ remain unverified.
versions.changelog: Added in-app Copy/Share debug reporting with real subscription, song and station catalog requests and NSError domain/code details, plus exportable Gecko EME test results and timeout handling. MusicKit signing capabilities and protected music EQ remain unverified.

versions.localizedDescription: Added native MusicKit mode with subscription and radio playback tests, native playback error reporting, packaged DRM module inventory, and in-app Gecko EME/Widevine/FairPlay probes. Paid-track EQ remains unsupported; native MusicKit access requires appropriate signing capabilities.
versions.changelog: Added native MusicKit mode with subscription and radio playback tests, native playback error reporting, packaged DRM module inventory, and in-app Gecko EME/Widevine/FairPlay probes. Paid-track EQ remains unsupported; native MusicKit access requires appropriate signing capabilities.

versions.localizedDescription: Added a genuine iOS Safari WebExtension containing Timbre's EQ engine, presets, controls, and effects. Full Safari Apple Music DRM audio EQ remains unverified; Gecko currently receives previews.
versions.changelog: Added a genuine iOS Safari WebExtension containing Timbre's EQ engine, presets, controls, and effects. Full Safari Apple Music DRM audio EQ remains unverified; Gecko currently receives previews.

versions.localizedDescription: Added a Gecko DRM capability test in About and corrected the full-track playback claim after a Safari comparison. Does not fix paid previews or Radio.
versions.changelog: Added a Gecko DRM capability test in About and corrected the full-track playback claim after a Safari comparison. Does not fix paid previews or Radio.

versions.localizedDescription: Renamed the standalone Gecko app, added native Home/New/Radio/Search/Library navigation and the Timbre popup. Radio remains unresolved.
versions.changelog: Renamed the standalone Gecko app, added native Home/New/Radio/Search/Library navigation and the Timbre popup. Radio remains unresolved.

apps.versionDescription: Rolled back build 10 Gecko view focus/activation behavior after a reported regression; returns to build 9 Gecko lifecycle. Audio output and protected playback remain unverified.

apps.name: Apple Music with Timbre
apps.subtitle: Apple Music web radio and audio access test
apps.localizedDescription: Version 0.3.0 opens Apple Music free radio in a web player and tests whether Web Audio can reach its signal. Web EQ activates only after samples are detected. Safari playback is confirmed, but app web playback and audible EQ need device verification. Native MusicKit remains experimental; imported unprotected audio retains Timbre EQ.
